metadata.title: Mammalian Cell Culture - Subculture (Passaging) of Adherent Cells
metadata.purpose: Maintain an adherent mammalian cell line in exponential growth by detaching cells at sub-confluence with trypsin-EDTA and reseeding at a defined split ratio or seeding density.
metadata.scope: Routine subculture of adherent, trypsin-sensitive mammalian cell lines in a humidified 37 degC / 5% CO2 incubator using aseptic technique in a Class II biosafety cabinet. Suspension cells and enzyme-sensitive lines are out of scope.
beforeYouBegin: Confirm the cell line identity, passage number, and expected doubling time (line-specific).
Warm medium, PBS, and trypsin-EDTA to 37 degC before use.
Work only in a certified, cleaned biosafety cabinet; decontaminate all surfaces and reagents entering the cabinet.

materials.name: Complete growth medium
materials.specification: Basal medium + serum (e.g. 10% FBS) + supplements +/- antibiotics; pre-warmed to 37 degC

steps.action: Examine cells for confluence and health.

steps.criticalNotes: Do not let the monolayer dry.

steps.action: Wash the monolayer with PBS; swirl and aspirate.
Add complete medium to neutralize trypsin.
(Optional) Centrifuge and resuspend in fresh medium.
Count viable cells with trypan blue.
Seed a new vessel by split ratio or defined density.
steps.criticalNotes: Distribute by gentle rocking, not swirling.

steps.action: Add complete medium; return to the incubator.

controls.name: Sterility / contamination check
controls.description: Inspect medium (turbidity, pH color) and cells by microscopy each passage; run a cell-free medium vessel if contamination is suspected.

expectedOutputs: A reseeded culture at the target density that reattaches and resumes exponential growth.
Recorded viable-cell count, % viability, split ratio/seeding density, and passage number.

troubleshooting.solution: Wash with PBS first; extend trypsin time; warm reagents
Shorten trypsin exposure; neutralize promptly; pipette gently
Discard culture; decontaminate cabinet; review technique
Increase seeding density; use fresh complete medium

safety: Human/primate cell lines are typically handled at BSL-2; follow institutional biosafety approval.
Use aseptic technique throughout; decontaminate waste and surfaces.
limitations: Line-specific values (medium, serum %, trypsin strength/time, seeding density, BSL) must be set for the actual cell line. This is generic adherent-cell subculture and does not cover specialised dissociation or cryopreservation.

sources.title: Standard adherent mammalian-cell subculture (ATCC animal-cell-culture guidelines; Freshney, Culture of Animal Cells)
sources.license: General method; no proprietary protocol text reproduced
